offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells medical devices and regenerative products for neurosurgery, neuro critical care, wound reconstruction, and surgical tissue repair. Customers are hospitals, surgeons and surgical centers. Products are made in company plants and sold mainly through direct sales forces.

primary_products.value: neurosurgical instruments and dural repair grafts; intracranial monitoring and drainage devices; ultrasonic tissue ablation systems; regenerative wound matrices and nerve repair products; breast reconstruction and soft tissue implants

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, ambulatory surgical centers, surgeons, wound care clinics; B2G: government and public hospitals in some countries

end_markets.value: neurosurgery; neuro critical care; plastic and reconstructive surgery; wound care; general and orthopedic surgery

revenue_model.value: product sales: single-use and capital medical devices, implants and regenerative matrices sold to hospitals

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures devices and tissue-based products from purchased materials, sold to hospitals and surgeons; brand owner: markets branded surgical product portfolios

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: specialty neurosurgery and tissue technologies, both serving surgeons and hospitals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales force selling to hospitals and surgeons; distributors / dealers: independent distributors in international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices and tissue products requiring FDA clearance or approval and EU MDR compliance
